name: To Questionnaire
description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.
longDescription: Invoked as `/to-questionnaire`, it interviews the user in **two exchanges** — who the recipient is (role, expertise, relationship) and what must come back (the decisions or facts the user cannot resolve alone) — then writes `to-questionnaire-<slug>.md` to the current directory. The document follows a template: purpose, from/to, a one-paragraph context, deadline and effort, themed `##` sections ordered most-important-first, one idea per question with an answer stub and an optional *why this matters* line, and a closing catch-all. Fill it in async or together in a meeting.
